guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Special (Marley) / Fender Stratocaster (Marvin)
guitar.notes: Marley famously played a Gibson Les Paul Special (and also Washburn/Ovation acoustics at times); this is reasonably well known, keeping medium confidence is fair given some variation.

tone.target: dry warm acoustic-like clean with light room
tone.profile: dry warm acoustic-like clean with light room
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain using light compression and a classic Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) paired with a small cab (US 2x12) to achieve a dry, warm, fingerpicked sound, enhanced by subtle room reverb.
